persona: Calm and precise. Scanned only the first page of the two-page quote with her phone; the second page is in a drawer at home and she can send it later.
initial_message: Hello, I'd like to report damage to my car. On Sunday 30 August I slid on loose gravel on a bend near Hawea Flat and the front left corner hit a rock on the bank. The bumper, headlight and front guard are damaged. I wasn't hurt and I drove home afterwards.

facts.incident.description: I was driving on a gravel road. On a bend the car slid on loose gravel towards the bank and the front left corner hit a large rock at the side of the road. I stopped, checked the damage and drove home slowly.
facts.incident.location: Gravel section of Quarry Test Road, Hawea Flat, near Wanaka
facts.incident.cause: Sliding on loose gravel on a bend and hitting a rock on the roadside bank
facts.loss.description: Front bumper corner cracked, left headlight cracked, front left guard dented
facts.claimant.address: 45 Ridgefern Test Avenue, Albert Town, Wanaka
facts.policyholder.name: Lucy Flaxmere
facts.vehicle.damage_description: Front bumper cracked and pushed in at the left corner, left headlight lens cracked, and a dent about 20 cm across in the front left guard above the wheel
facts.driver.name: Lucy Flaxmere
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the front left corner taken at the roadside. Available now.
facts.evidence.repair_quote: Quote from Cedar Holt Auto Refinish dated 2 September 2026. It has two pages; I only scanned the first page with my phone. The second page is in a drawer at home and I can send it later.
facts.if_asked_about_quote_total: I think it was about $3,100 including GST, but that is on the second page, which I have not sent yet.
facts.if_asked_about_the_road: It is a public gravel road. I did not damage any fence or property, only the car.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo on a rural gravel road in bright afternoon sun, close-up of the front left corner of a small white hatchback. The plastic bumper corner is cracked and pushed inward, the headlight lens beside it has a long crack, and the curved wing panel above the front wheel is dented, with grey dust and gravel scuffs on the paint. Dry tussock grass and a rocky roadside bank in the background. The frame shows only the corner, the headlight and the front wheel; the centre of the bumper and the grille are outside the frame. No licence plate, no badges, no logos, no text, no people.

design.notes: Only page 1 of the two-page repair quote is supplied; page 2 with the totals and terms is missing, and the page footer still reads 'Page 1 of 2'. The quote date is on page 1. The current policy period started on 1 August 2026, 29 days before the incident, but that is a renewal: the policy was first taken out on 1 August 2020. A system that read the current period start as inception would wrongly add review_hint.

triage.rationale: The repair quote is missing its second page with the total, so someone must chase it. Single vehicle, no other party, nobody hurt, car drivable, one clear photo, policy on file, so nothing is complex. Page 1 shows only the line items and the claimant can give only her recollection of the total (about NZD 3,100), so whether the amount counts as known is left open. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no uncertainty marker in the lookup, and coverage = review_required on its own does not count (maintainer, 2026-09-30). The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: No receipt or ownership document in the pack

quote_before_loss.basis: The quote date is on the retained page 1: 2 September 2026, after the incident on 30 August 2026. The removed page 2 holds only the totals and terms.

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 August 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2020-08-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear. The current period started 29 days before the incident only because of a renewal.
